text:
aisha: AM shift briefing — queue at hand: 12 open, 3 high-priority (2 infra, 1 billing). Known issue: customers reporting duplicate charges on embedding retries. Macros need a small update to include refund language + KB link. I'm handing the billing case to @tom. If volume spikes above 20, we'll pull an extra engineer.

 tom: taking the billing case (S1). I'll ack customers and post updates here. @ravi can you do a quick macro patch and push?

 ravi: on it. Drafting a short macro now. Suggested text: 
```
Macro ID: billing-duplicate-charge
Title: Duplicate charge (auto-refund + follow-up)
Response:
Hi — we're sorry for the duplicate charge. We've issued an immediate refund for the duplicate charge and are investigating. Please confirm if you still see duplicate charges after 24 hours. If yes, reply and we'll escalate.
```
I'll push v2 to staging and ping for review.

 sam: can review the macro diff at ~11:30. Also noticing a small surge of tickets tagged "embed-timeout" — recommend a temporary macro to circulate with troubleshooting steps.

 deploy-bot: macro deploy succeeded: billing-duplicate-charge v2 -> prod (deployed by ravi) :white_check_mark:

 aisha: nice, thanks. Action list: 1) @tom handle customer communications with the new macro, 2) @ravi update KB page and attach macro link, 3) @sam review post-deploy. I'll update the triage doc and adjust routing if volume increases.

 kb-bot: KB updated: /kb/billing/duplicate-charge -> https://kb.redwood.example/billing/duplicate-charge :link:

 tom: FYI I used this short reply template for initial customer messages: 
```
Hi — sorry for the trouble. We've issued a refund for the duplicate charge. Can you confirm whether you still see a duplicate charge after 24 hours? (Ticket ref: #12345)
```

 aisha: perfect. leave any follow-ups here. if anyone picks up extra capacity please shout. :coffee:
